issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: dandelion, fern, oxeye_daisy, cauldron, allium, sweet_berry_bush, cornflower, brewing_stand, candle, white_wall_banner, brick_stairs.
447 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.artefacts: The bench at (9,0,1),(9,0,2) is spruce_stairs facing=east: the backrest is on the outside and the seat faces the house wall at x=8. Also the front ridge gap at (5,6,1).
notes.roof: Overhang warning is a false alarm: 1 block of overhang all round.
notes.life: Herb bed with berries, ferns and flowers, leaf bushes, scattered flowers and a lantern post.
notes.depth: Garden and bushes soften the base, but the walls themselves are still flat.

visual.summary: L2 plus a fenced herb bed along the west side, more banners, extra herb pots, bushes and flowers, a bench and a lantern post: the infirmary now sits in its own garden.
problems: Bench at (9,0,1),(9,0,2) faces the wrong way (facing=east puts the seat against the wall): use facing=west.
Front barge board hole under the ridge at (5,6,1) carried over from L1.
Herb-bed end fences at (0,0..1,3) and (0,0..1,10) are lone 2-high posts; a low 1-high fence or trapdoor edging would read better.
Reachability: ward, aisle, lean-to and garden reached; unreached are only roof slopes, box/canopy tops and shelf tops. Fine.

notes.purpose: Job reads inside (beds, brewing stand, cauldron, herb garden), but no red cross is visible: the front banner at (5,4,1) and the two banners on the front posts at (2,3,1) and (8,3,1) render plain white; their crosses exist only as decoration-step notes.
notes.artefacts: Carlton's note on v1 ('Add a red cross or something to show that its a hospital') is not met: the cross is only a decoration-step note in the generator, banners render plain white (the Studio file can't carry banner patterns). RUBRIC: a version that ignores one of his notes can't pass 'No mistakes'. Build the cross from blocks on the front gable
notes.roof: One-block overhang and barge boards; the automatic 'no overhang' warning is a false alarm.
notes.depth: Side and back walls still flat apart from boxes and the garden.
notes.levels: Adds a herb garden, a bench, a lantern post, herb pots and more banners: a visible new outdoor herb-garden feature over L2.

visual.summary: L2 plus a fenced herb garden, herb pots, a bench by the door, a lantern post and more banners. Hole and bench are fixed; the red cross still only exists as a decoration note, so the banners show plain white.
problems: Red cross not visible: the white banners at (5,4,1) and on the front posts at (2,3,1) and (8,3,1) show plain white; the cross is only a decoration-step note. Build the cross in blocks (as in L1/L2, e.g. red_wool plus at (5,4..6,2),(4,5,2),(6,5,2) on the front gable) so it is visible without the decoration step.
Herb-bed end fences at (0,0..1,3) and (0,0..1,10) are still lone 2-high posts; optional.
Reachability: ward, aisle, lean-to and garden reached; unreached are only roof slopes, box and canopy tops and shelf tops. Fine.
